caption: The drawing features a single horizontal decorative band positioned near the center of a plain, beige background. The band is bordered on the top and bottom by dark greenish-black lines. Within the band, there is a repeated pattern composed of small geometric shapes and stylized floral elements. The predominant colors within the decorative band are shades of green, teal, and burgundy. Circular green forms are interspersed evenly along the band, each accompanied by smaller leaf-like shapes in lighter green, and are set against a background that features alternating burgundy triangular elements. The rest of the space around the band is left blank except for a small, handwritten signature or mark located in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Wall Paper Border
